doc: stages/filters.decimation.rst: 'The **decimation filter** retains every Nth point from an input point view.' and its Options block: step 'Number of points to skip between each sample point.  A step of 1 will skip no points.  A step of 2 will skip every other point.  A step of 100 will reduce the input by ~99%. A step of 1.6 will retain ``100 / 1.6 = 62.5%`` of the points. [Default: 1.0]'  The documented worked example is 1.6 -> 100/1.6 = 62.5%, so the 1000-point lattice keeps 625 points.
